searchText: Anyone know what the origin of using "she" for unknown people in cryptography comes from? I've seen/heard it a few times I don't know the answer, but my guess would be that it refers to Alice. Who is, normally together with Bob, used as placeholder for sender and receiver of cryptographic messages. that's my guess too but I've been looking around and can't even find anyone mentioning this little quirk at all top tier fun fact though
